not_reuse_examples: [40] Yedida & Menzies code-smell HPO study: cited in the introduction only as motivation that HPO is slow; not run or compared.
[68]/[32]/[33] Hyperopt/TPE and Optuna: described in the HPO taxonomy (Fig. 5 boxed methods) but explicitly not executed in the experiments.
[121]-[123] DietCode, SlimCode, Avatar, SimPy: related-work positioning of LLM simplification only; nothing reused.
[53]-[55] Pearson / Jolliffe PCA and [57]-[64] feature/row pruning results: background argument for the manifold assumption, not applied.
notes: Empirical HPO study (LITE vs random vs DEHB on 50 SE + non-SE datasets, 20 repeats); most edges are datasets; Wine Quality has no reference; the MOOT source-paper edges are low-confidence because datasets were drawn from MOOT rather than from those papers directly.
